verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships a built-in AI assistant that drafts replies, auto-labels/archives mail, answers natural-language questions (Ask AI), and lets users build proactive agents via chat or visual builder with triggers and connectors, with admin governance over agent permissions (superhuman-docs-2,4,14,18,27,52,59,61,62). This goes beyond simple automation into actual task delegation to an in-app AI agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the agent-builder and delegation features (all evidence is vendor docs) and no community corroboration specifically of the AI assistant's task-delegation reliability.
